tickets.subject: Charged twice for subscription
tickets.body: I was billed $49 twice this month. My invoice number is INV-2045. Please refund one of the charges immediately.

tickets.subject: App crashes on login
tickets.body: Every time I try to log in from the mobile app, it crashes immediately. This started after the update yesterday. iOS 17, iPhone 14.

tickets.subject: How do I export my data?
tickets.body: I want to download all my data before cancelling. I cannot find the export option in settings. Can you point me in the right direction?

tickets.subject: Feature request: dark mode
tickets.body: Please add a dark mode option to the dashboard. Staring at the white background for hours is very straining. Would love this in a future update.

tickets.subject: Cannot reset password
tickets.body: I clicked forgot password but never received the reset email. I checked spam. My email is user@example.com. This is urgent as I have a meeting soon.

tickets.subject: API returning 500 errors
tickets.body: Our integration has been throwing 500 errors since 2am UTC. Endpoint: /api/v2/reports. This is blocking our entire data pipeline for 3000 users.

tickets.subject: Upgrade plan question
tickets.body: What is included in the Pro plan compared to Starter? I want to know if I get more API calls and if SSO is included before upgrading.

tickets.subject: Invoice missing company name
tickets.body: Our last three invoices do not show our company name. We need this for accounting purposes. Company: Acme Corp, Account ID 8821.

tickets.subject: Dashboard loads very slowly
tickets.body: The main dashboard takes 15-20 seconds to load. This used to be instant. Our team of 40 people is complaining about this constantly.

tickets.subject: Two-factor auth not working
tickets.body: After enabling 2FA the code never arrives by SMS. I have tried 6 times. My phone number is verified in the account settings.

tickets.subject: Refund request - cancelled subscription
tickets.body: I cancelled my subscription on the 1st but was still charged on the 5th. I would like a full refund of $99 for this month.

tickets.subject: CSV import fails silently
tickets.body: When I upload a CSV file with 5000 rows the import appears to succeed but no data shows up. Smaller files under 100 rows work fine.

tickets.subject: Add Slack notifications
tickets.body: We would love to receive alert notifications in Slack when a new ticket is created. This would save us from checking the dashboard constantly.

tickets.subject: Account locked after failed logins
tickets.body: My account got locked after 3 failed login attempts. I cannot wait for the unlock email because I am presenting to a client in 20 minutes.

tickets.subject: Webhook events not firing
tickets.body: Our webhook endpoint is not receiving events for the order.completed event type. Other event types work. Verified the endpoint is live and reachable.

tickets.subject: Wrong plan shown on billing page
tickets.body: My billing page still shows the Basic plan even though I upgraded to Pro two weeks ago. I was charged the Pro price so the upgrade did go through.

tickets.subject: How to add team members?
tickets.body: I am the account owner and want to add 5 new people to my workspace. I cannot find an invite option. Can you walk me through the steps?

tickets.subject: Search returning no results
tickets.body: The search bar on the records page returns no results for any query. I type a name I can see in the list and nothing comes up. Broken since yesterday.

tickets.subject: Request: bulk delete records
tickets.body: We need a way to select and delete multiple records at once. Currently we have to delete them one by one which takes forever for large cleanups.

tickets.subject: Data not syncing with Salesforce
tickets.body: Our Salesforce integration stopped syncing contacts 3 days ago. No error in logs. The connection status shows green but no new data is coming through.

tickets.subject: Accidental card charge
tickets.body: An extra charge of $9.99 appeared on my card. I do not recognise what this is for. Transaction date was June 3rd. Please investigate.

tickets.subject: SSL certificate error on subdomain
tickets.body: Our custom subdomain app.client.com is showing an SSL error to all users. Certificate expired yesterday. This is a production issue affecting all customers.

tickets.subject: Can I change my username?
tickets.body: I created my account with my personal email username and would like to change it to something more professional. Is this possible?

tickets.subject: Mobile app suggestion: fingerprint login
tickets.body: It would be great if the mobile app supported fingerprint or Face ID login instead of typing the password every time.

tickets.subject: Reports not generating
tickets.body: Every time I click Generate Report I get a spinning loader and after 2 minutes it just shows a blank page. No error message.

tickets.subject: Annual vs monthly billing
tickets.body: If I switch from monthly to annual billing mid-cycle will I be charged immediately? How is the proration calculated?

tickets.subject: Collaborator cannot access shared project
tickets.body: I added a collaborator to my project but they receive a permission denied error when they try to open it. I set them as editor.

tickets.subject: Email notifications going to spam
tickets.body: All notification emails are landing in my spam folder. I have whitelisted your domain but they still go there. Using Gmail.

tickets.subject: Request: API rate limit increase
tickets.body: We are hitting the 1000 req/min rate limit in production. Our use case requires at least 5000 req/min. How do we request an increase?

tickets.subject: Database connection pool exhausted
tickets.body: Application error: connection pool exhausted. Started at 08:45 UTC. All write operations failing across all regions. This is a P0 incident.

tickets.subject: Incorrect tax on invoice
tickets.body: Our invoices are being charged VAT at 20% but we are VAT exempt. I have uploaded our VAT exemption certificate but the charge remains.

tickets.subject: File uploads fail above 10MB
tickets.body: Any file upload above 10MB fails with a network error. The file size limit in our plan is listed as 100MB so this seems like a bug.

tickets.subject: Add calendar sync feature
tickets.body: Please build a Google Calendar integration so tasks with due dates automatically appear in our calendar. This is our most requested feature.

tickets.subject: Forgot my 2FA backup codes
tickets.body: I set up 2FA but lost my backup codes and my phone was reset. I can verify my identity via my original signup email and payment details.

tickets.subject: Graph rendering incorrect data
tickets.body: The revenue graph on the analytics page is showing numbers that do not match our actual revenue. The discrepancy is about 15% lower than real values.

tickets.subject: Downgrade subscription
tickets.body: I want to downgrade from Pro to Starter. Does the downgrade take effect immediately or at the end of the billing cycle? Will I lose any data?

tickets.subject: New user onboarding question
tickets.body: I just signed up and I am not sure how to get started. Is there a walkthrough or tutorial video that explains the main features?

tickets.subject: Memory leak in browser tab
tickets.body: After leaving the dashboard open for 2+ hours the browser tab uses 4GB of RAM and becomes unusable. Happens in Chrome 124 and Firefox 125.

tickets.subject: Request: custom domain for client portal
tickets.body: We want to use our own domain for the client-facing portal instead of your subdomain. Is white-labelling available on any plan?

tickets.subject: Cannot delete account
tickets.body: I have been trying to delete my account for a week. The delete button in settings just refreshes the page without any action.

tickets.subject: Charged after cancellation
tickets.body: I cancelled on April 30th and have confirmation email, but was still charged on May 1st. I want this charge reversed immediately.

tickets.subject: Email template variables not rendering
tickets.body: In our email campaigns, variables like {{first_name}} are showing as literal text instead of the customer's name. Was working fine last week.

tickets.subject: Request: more color themes
tickets.body: The current blue theme is fine but it would be nice to have more options like green or purple to match different brand colors.

tickets.subject: SSO not working with Okta
tickets.body: Our Okta SAML SSO setup was working until yesterday. Now users get redirected to an error page after authenticating with Okta. SAML assertions are valid.

tickets.subject: PDF export has missing images
tickets.body: When exporting a report to PDF, all embedded images are missing. The images show fine in the browser view. Started happening this week.

tickets.subject: Credit card update failed
tickets.body: I tried to update my credit card details 3 times but keep getting a payment method update failed error. My card is valid and has no issues.

tickets.subject: What happens to data when trial ends?
tickets.body: My free trial ends in 3 days. If I do not upgrade will my data be deleted? How long is it retained if I decide to come back later?

tickets.subject: Notifications not dismissing
tickets.body: When I click the X to dismiss a notification it disappears momentarily then reappears. The notification badge count also never decreases.

tickets.subject: Request: keyboard shortcuts
tickets.body: Power users like me would benefit greatly from keyboard shortcuts for common actions like creating a new record, search, and save.

tickets.subject: All data disappeared after update
tickets.body: After the platform update last night all of our project data is gone. 6 months of work. This is a critical emergency. Please escalate immediately.
